rules: 全Candidateを同一Pilot・同一Capability集合で評価する。
nativeはCandidateの公式packageが直接提供する安定API、compositionは同Candidateの公開APIだけを組み合わせる解決とする。
extensionは追加のMeridian codeまたは別dependencyを必要とし、commercialは有料license境界、unresolvedは安全な解決を確認できない状態とする。
responsive layoutはComponent libraryへ偽装せず、Meridian generator-owned capabilityとして分離する。
公式documentationによるcontract coverageと実Browser evidenceを分離し、Browser Matrix完了前にReference Adapterを推薦しない。

pilots.name: Team Invitation
pilots.structuralProfile: 複数Entity作成、対象別属性、Review before commit、非同期Partial result。

capabilities.description: Label、description、errorへ関連付いたtext input。
Keyboard操作可能な単一option selection。
高影響事項を明示確認するnamed boolean control。
必要時にfocus lifecycleを所有するmodal boundary。
対象別field groupを追加、削除、検証する反復editor。
非同期処理と対象別結果を非色依存で通知する。
Project semantic tokenとLight、Dark、High Contrastを対応付ける。
同じfield relationをDesktop、Tablet、Mobileへ適応する。
長い翻訳、locale data、RTL方向へ対応する。

pilots.name: Issue Triage
pilots.structuralProfile: 高密度Collection比較、sorting、selection、row action、detail disclosure、継続処理。

capabilities.description: 列または属性で並び替え可能な比較Collection。
対象を複数選択し選択状態を支援技術へ伝える。
条件を追加・解除し結果件数を更新する。
大量Collectionを位置情報付きで分割移動する。
対象を明示した行単位ActionをKeyboardで実行する。
選択対象の詳細を文脈とfocusを保って開閉する。
意味と操作性を維持して作業密度を切り替える。
大量データでも意味、focus、selectionを維持して描画量を制御する。
Collection内navigation、sorting、selection、ActionをKeyboardで完了する。
Desktop比較とMobile一件処理を同じ責務・data modelで提供する。
Project semantic tokenとLight、Dark、High Contrastを対応付ける。
長い翻訳、locale data、RTL方向へ対応する。

candidates.name: shadcn/ui
candidates.licenseBoundary: Copied registry items become project-owned source; every transitive base, icon, table, date, and registry dependency still requires item-level license and version provenance.
runtimeDependencies: Selected base: React Aria, Radix, or Base UI

capabilities.resolution: Input and Field source items
capabilities.notes: Generated source remains locally inspectable.

capabilities.resolution: Select source item using the selected base
capabilities.notes: Behavior version follows the chosen base and must be recorded separately.

capabilities.resolution: Checkbox source item
capabilities.notes: Label and description composition remains application-owned.

capabilities.resolution: Dialog source item
capabilities.notes: Focus behavior follows the chosen base package.

capabilities.resolution: Form fields, table or grouped rows, validation, and row actions
capabilities.notes: No single canonical batch editor; Meridian owns data and focus coordination.

capabilities.resolution: Button pending state, Alert, and project live region
capabilities.notes: Target-by-target partial result is application composition.

capabilities.resolution: Project-owned CSS variables and preset application
capabilities.notes: Open-code ownership supports direct DTCG alias output but increases drift responsibility.

capabilities.resolution: Meridian layout recipe and logical source order
capabilities.notes: Responsive responsibility is not delegated to a component registry.

capabilities.resolution: CLI RTL transform with logical utilities and RTL examples
capabilities.notes: Locale data and translated strings remain application inputs.

capabilities.resolution: Input, Select, badges, and table state
capabilities.notes: Result announcement is application-owned.

capabilities.resolution: Pagination source with table state

capabilities.resolution: Sheet, Collapsible, or route detail

capabilities.resolution: Meridian density tokens applied to copied source
capabilities.notes: No shared density contract across arbitrary registry items.

capabilities.resolution: Additional virtualizer integrated with table state

capabilities.resolution: Selected table engine plus explicit keyboard and focus contract

capabilities.resolution: Project-owned CSS variables
capabilities.notes: Direct mapping is possible but update merges remain project-owned.

capabilities.resolution: CLI RTL transform and logical utilities
capabilities.notes: Third-party table engines need separate RTL verification.

capabilities.resolution: Radix Checkbox
capabilities.notes: Visible impact explanation remains application content.

capabilities.resolution: Meridian composition over native fields and Radix controls
capabilities.notes: No collection or batch-editor primitive.

capabilities.resolution: Radix Toast plus persistent result region
capabilities.notes: Partial result data model remains Meridian-owned.

capabilities.resolution: Meridian CSS variables style unstyled primitive parts
capabilities.notes: Strong styling freedom but no finished theme mapping.

capabilities.resolution: Meridian layout recipe
capabilities.notes: Layout stays outside primitive resolution.

capabilities.resolution: Direction provider and logical Meridian CSS
capabilities.notes: Application owns translated content and formatting.
No first-party table or collection sorting primitive.

capabilities.resolution: Native table or list with Radix Checkbox and Meridian selection state
capabilities.notes: Collection semantics and range selection are application-owned.

capabilities.resolution: Native input plus Meridian query state

capabilities.resolution: Dropdown Menu or visible controls

capabilities.resolution: Direction provider and logical CSS

capabilities.resolution: Button pending state, Toast, and persistent status region

capabilities.resolution: Meridian layout recipe

capabilities.resolution: Table selection model

capabilities.resolution: Meridian pagination composition over Button and collection state
capabilities.notes: No confirmed first-party Pagination component in the pinned package.

capabilities.resolution: Table Row with MenuTrigger or visible Button

capabilities.resolution: Meridian density tokens and layout styles

capabilities.resolution: Pinned and separately verified virtualizer integration
capabilities.notes: Virtualization stability must be proven in the browser spike.

capabilities.resolution: Table collection keyboard and focus behavior

capabilities.resolution: Meridian responsive-switch layout recipe

capabilities.resolution: Meridian CSS variables and state selectors
capabilities.notes: High Contrast styling remains adapter work.

capabilities.resolution: Built-in RTL and internationalized interactions

capabilities.resolution: Data Grid actions column

requiredChecks: Team Invitation primary path and partial failure
Issue Triage sorting, selection, row action, detail disclosure, and large collection
Keyboard order, visible focus, accessible names, state announcements, and focus restoration
Long Japanese, RTL, 200 percent zoom, High Contrast, and touch targets
Rendered output size, dependency footprint, runtime warnings, client mount stability, and touch target geometry
blockers: VoiceOver plus Chrome manual journeys are pending for every candidate and both Pilots.
Browser UI zoom at 200 percent is pending; automated CSS zoom is supporting evidence only.
Windows High Contrast evaluation is pending in a Windows environment.
Automated browser evidence cannot establish accessibility conformance or select a candidate.
